info.title: API.SH: CoinGecko
info.description: The CoinGecko API from API.SH: public CoinGecko data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

get.description:
Every CoinGecko coin category (Layer 1, DeFi, Meme, AI...) with its description, market cap, 24 h market cap change, 24 h volume and its top 3 coins. Sort with `order`; filter by name with `q`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coingecko-categories

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only categories whose name or id contains this text.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows to return, up to 1000 (default all).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Derivatives on CoinGecko. `view=exchanges` (default): derivatives exchanges with open interest and 24 h volume in BTC and their perpetual and futures pair counts, paged. `view=tickers`: every perpetual and futures contract with price, index, basis, spread, funding rate, open interest and 24 h volume in USD; filter by symbol with `q` and by `contract_type`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coingecko-derivatives

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: view=tickers: only symbols containing this text or with this index (e.g. BTC).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows per page (exchanges up to 100, tickers up to 20000).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

items.name: Hyperliquid (Futures)
items.description: Hyperliquid is a decentralized perpetual futures order book exchange on its own L1.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coingecko-exchange

parameters.name: id

parameters.name: coins
parameters.description: Only tickers of these coins, comma-separated CoinGecko coin ids.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The top gaining and losing coins over 1 h, 24 h, 7 d, 14 d, 30 d or 1 y among the largest coins by market cap (top 250, 500 or 1000), skipping coins under a minimum 24 h volume: price, market cap, volume and the change in percent.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coingecko-gainers-losers

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: How many coins by market cap to compare (default 1000).

parameters.name: min_volume
parameters.description: Minimum 24 h volume in the currency (default 50000).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Gainers and losers to return each, up to 250 (default 30).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Global crypto market stats from CoinGecko: active coins, markets, total market cap and volume in a currency, 24 h market cap change, market cap dominance per coin, ICO counts, and DeFi market cap, volume and dominance.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coingecko-global

parameters.name: vs
parameters.description: Currency for market cap and volume (default usd).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Historical price, market cap and volume chart for a coin: a timestamped point list plus first and last price, high, low and percentage change. Granularity follows the range (5-minute for 1 day, hourly up to 90 days, daily beyond). History is limited to the last 365 days; days=max returns those 365 days.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coingecko-history

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Coin id, or a coingecko.com coin URL.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Range start as unix seconds or YYYY-MM-DD (use with to, instead of days).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Range end as unix seconds or YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: Set to daily to force daily points.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Coins ranked by market cap (or volume): price, market cap, rank, volume, 24 h high/low, price change for 1 h, 24 h, 7 d, 14 d, 30 d, 200 d and 1 y, supply, all-time high/low and ROI. Filter by category or by ids. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coingecko-markets

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: market_cap_desc (default), market_cap_asc, volume_desc, volume_asc, id_asc or id_desc.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category id, e.g. layer-1, decentralized-finance-defi, meme-token.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
NFT collections tracked by CoinGecko. Without `id`: the collection list (id, name, symbol, chain, contract) sorted by market cap, volume or floor price, filterable by chain, paged. With `id`: one collection with floor price, market cap and 24 h volume (native and USD), their changes over 24 h to 1 y, all-time high, owners, supply, 24 h sales, links and explorers.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coingecko-nfts

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: One collection: CoinGecko NFT id or coingecko.com/en/nft/<id> link.

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: List: only this chain (asset platform id, e.g. ethereum, solana).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: List rows per page, up to 250 (default 100).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Search coins, exchanges, categories and NFTs
get.description:
Search CoinGecko by name, symbol or id. Returns matching coins (id, symbol, name, market cap rank, thumbnail and image), exchanges, categories and NFT collections. Use a coin id with the coin and history routes.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coingecko-search

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Limit results to one kind: all (default), coins, exchanges, categories or nfts.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A coin's trading pairs on every exchange CoinGecko tracks: last price, volume, USD and BTC converted price and volume, bid/ask spread, trust score, staleness, last trade time, trade link and (with `depth`) the cost to move the price 2 % up or down. 100 per page; pass `next_page` back as `page`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coingecko-tickers

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: CoinGecko coin id or coingecko.com coin link.

parameters.name: exchanges
parameters.description: Only these exchanges, comma-separated CoinGecko exchange ids (e.g. binance,kraken).

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Add the 2 % order-book depth (cost to move up/down).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
What is trending on CoinGecko in the last 24 hours: the top coins (rank, price, 24 h change, market cap, volume, sparkline), NFT collections (floor price and change) and categories.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/coingecko-trending

parameters.name: vs
parameters.description: Currency for the 24 h change figures (default usd).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
